readings: For each circuit country, compute the average constructorStandings.points and average constructorStandings.wins across all constructor standings rows for races held in that country. Then show how far each country's average wins is above or below the unweighted mean of the per-country average wins, so each country counts equally.

For each circuit country, compute the average constructorStandings.points and average constructorStandings.wins across all constructor standings rows for races held in that country. Then show how far each country's average wins is above or below the overall average wins across all constructor standings rows in every country, so countries with more rows weigh more.
queries:
SELECT country,
       avg_points,
       avg_wins,
       avg_wins - AVG(avg_wins) OVER () AS wins_diff_from_mean
FROM (
  SELECT c.country AS country,
         AVG(cs.points) AS avg_points,
         AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_wins
  FROM constructorStandings cs
  JOIN races r ON cs.raceId = r.raceId
  JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
  GROUP BY c.country
);
SELECT c.country,
       AVG(cs.points) AS avg_points,
       AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_wins,
       AVG(cs.wins) - (SELECT AVG(wins) FROM constructorStandings) AS wins_diff_from_overall
FROM constructorStandings cs
JOIN races r ON cs.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
GROUP BY c.country;
